name: G. Gorham Bond
role: Of the Little Missouri Horse Co.; Billings County Republican delegate
bio: G. Gorham Bond of the Little Missouri Horse Co. reported in February 1885 that the company's horses were thriving in the cold and snow. In 1886 he received 70 votes in the April county election, signed a September caucus call, was elected a Billings County delegate to the Republican convention at Bismarck, and was listed among the successful candidates that November.
